title: Mixed Event — Screaming?! Welcome to the Forest of Wolves!

meta.Event: Screaming?! Welcome to the Forest of Wolves!
meta.Outline: The Miya Girls School Festival is fast approaching. Kohane was thinking about inviting the rest of Vivid BAD SQUAD and wondering what they could do throughout the day, but her class, 1-A, decided to do something An's not very fond of... A haunted house!

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Class President
rows.Line: So, for the School Festival, our class...

rows.Speaker: Class President
rows.Line: ...by a majority vote, will be doing a haunted house!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I was hoping that we'd do a cafe, but that fell short by five votes.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But a haunted house seems like an essential part of any school festival, so it should be fun. Does this mean we get to make gravestones, wells and other things like that for it?)

rows.Speaker: Class President
rows.Line: We'll decide on the details during homeroom tomorrow. Please keep in mind that we may need to stay late after school in order to prepare everything for it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, I should tell the others if I'm going to have to stay late to work on this...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I hope they really enjoy our School Festival...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Kohane!
Looks like things are decided!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Minori, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I sorta wasn't expecting the haunted house to win. I was hoping for something else since it sounded like a lot of work...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. It might be a little tough since we'll have to figure out a design that fits inside this classroom.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I'm actually kind of looking forward to seeing how our haunted house turns out.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know! We should make it just like the one at PXL! I remember having so much fun there when I was little!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, are you talking about Phenny's Nightmare? The one where Phenny wanders inside an old mansion...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, that! Phenny was as cute as ever, but it was actually really scary inside...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And it's great during Halloween because they have zombies come after you in the mirror room!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
I went with Ichika and the others a while back... You should've seen the looks on Saki and Honami's faces.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Phenny's Nightmare is really popular because it offers a nice balance of cuteness and fear.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: On top of that, they change how the monsters look and when they're supposed to jump out depending on the season to make sure it never gets old!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Really? That's pretty interesting.
You really do know a ton about PXL, huh, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I do sort of visit a lot...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, that's it... I thought I didn't know much about haunted houses at first, but this seems like a good way to come up with ideas for ours.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's make our haunted house really fun and thrilling!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, since we're doing one, we should probably make it as fun as possible.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, let's do our best to make that happen!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yeah!
Park

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay...
It's getting pretty late, so why don't we stop here for today?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Man, we sang so much!
Our song this time around is turning out really well too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. And your singing is very encouraging, Shiraishi. I have a feeling that the audience is going to go wild during the chorus.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. But it isn't perfect yet, so we gotta keep working on it during practice tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
Let's meet again at the same time after school!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, about that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm really sorry, but I have to help prepare for our School Festival starting tomorrow. I'm probably going to be late to practice for the foreseeable future...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, is the Miya Girls School Festival already just around the corner?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see.
It's a school event, so there's not much we can do.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Plus, you can make up for it by practicing when you can.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thanks...!
I promise to do my best to not fall behind!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
All good!
More importantly, we get to go, right?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, um... I was actually going to invite you all today...! So... I hope you can all come!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Of course!
By the way, what's your class gonna do?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... A haunted house...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Also, An, I vaguely remember hearing something about you being afraid of ghosts... Is that because...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Um, well... That's not important!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Right...
An's afraid of ghosts...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What's wrong, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know! Your class is doing a maid cafe, right? With outfits that are a little too embarrassing to wear...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
N-No, actually...
We're, umm...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We're doing a haunted house...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: R-R-R-R-R-Really...?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Th-The kind where you put drapes up all over your classroom and hang konjac jelly from the ceiling, right?! Th-That sounds like fun...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-An...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Your idea of a haunted house sounds ancient. Also, why are you so acting so jittery all of a sudden...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hang on. I remember someone saying how... Now I get it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Shiraishi, you don't look well.
Are you okay...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
She fine. She isn't sick...
Just scared...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
H-Huh...?!
Wh-What are you talking about?! I'm not scared!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-An, you don't have to visit my class if you don't feel like you're up to it. There's plenty more things we could do together...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I-I'll be fine!
I can't not go, Kohane! I'm definitely stopping by your class...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: B-But I'd feel so lonely if I went by myself, so let's all go together, okay...?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are we actually allowed to go...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! I want you guys to come, so I got tickets for all of you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We really don't have much time to play around...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I guess we can make an exception for this. I'm looking forward to seeing how scary your haunted house is gonna be.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Akito, didn't your class also do a haunted house during our School Festival? It actually ended up being quite a bit of fun.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We did put a lot of effort into making it as scary as we could. I mean, a haunted house isn't exactly gonna feel haunted if it isn't scary.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
A-Anyway, we're going...!
We promise to stop by your class, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
Thanks, you guys.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Th-The Miya Girls School Festival! I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Your voice sounds really weird.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (An might not have fun if she has to deal with scary monsters...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Is there anything we can do to make sure she gets to enjoy herself...?)
The next day

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Class President
rows.Line: Okay. Today, let's start coming up with ideas for our haunted house. Do any of you already happen to have suggestions ready?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, I do!
Can we chase everyone around as zombies?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We'd be super scary, and it'd be fun to make everyone scream and run!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: I was hoping that it'd be more like a house of dolls. It'd be pretty creepy if we all brought the dolls we played with when we were little, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Eep! That does sound creepy!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Or how about a really long tunnel?
We could have weird sounds play in the background and have people follow our visitors.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wow, everyone's already come up with a lot of ideas...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
And they're all really good. I have a feeling that our haunted house is going to be pretty scary.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Isn't there a way to make our haunted house enjoyable for those who don't exactly like ghosts?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But if we do that, our haunted house probably won't be very scary...)

rows.Speaker: Class President
rows.Line:
Thank you for your suggestions.
Any more ideas out there? If not, I'd like for us to start choosing which to go with...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hmm... What else can we do...?
Oh, I know!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What if we took the opposite approach and made our haunted house really cute?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Didn't you say how the haunted house at PXL is really popular because it offers a good mix of cuteness and fear?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi... My friend even said that ideas are sometimes more interesting when they take the opposite approach!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I like your idea...
But I'm having trouble wrapping my head around a “cute” haunted house.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, really?
Hmm... How about...? I know!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What if we based it off a fairytale?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A fairytale...? Like “Little Red Riding Hood” or “The Wolf and the Seven Young Goats”?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Making it cute would be a lot easier if we based our haunted house off one of those stories, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, that could be fun since it'll feel a little different from a traditional haunted house...

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Decorating it might be fun too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really? Yay!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: But what about the ghosts and monsters and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Yeah, not many fairytales have them in their stories... Would witches work?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Little Red Riding Hood has the wolf...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Little Red Riding Hood... The wolf...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's actually kind of a scary story since Little Red Riding Hood gets eaten by the wolf. But not that scary.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, maybe it's because you know that the hunter's going to use his gun to rescue her in the end...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hm?
Did you get an idea, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah.
How about...something like this?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: First, we'd turn our classroom into a forest.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: As our visitors walk in, they'll become lost, thereby becoming Little Red Riding Hood or the goats.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mhmm, go on!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then, we'll be the wolves who go after them as they try to navigate their way towards the exit... How does that sound...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hey, that sounds pretty fun.
That means they'll actually get to be those characters.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Exactly. But that's not all...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was thinking that they could also choose someone to be the hunter.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The hunter?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Anyone chosen to be a hunter will be given a toy gun that will allow them to chase away any wolves.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, interesting.
That means they'll get to enjoy our haunted house in a couple of different ways.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I see! The people who want to experience the haunted house as a haunted house can choose to be Little Red Riding Hood or the goats...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And those who want to experience it as a game can go after the wolves!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Whoa! That sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Multiple options mean our visitors can go through it multiple times! I vote for this!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Class President
rows.Line: Okay, we seem to have strong approval for this idea, so let's go with this idea!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Th-Thank goodness...!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The idea you came up with just now was so good, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You think so?
Hehe. Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I was only able to arrive on that because of you, Minori. There's no way I would've thought of doing a haunted house based on a fairytale if you hadn't said what you said...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: All of the things you've been doing with MORE MORE JUMP! might be turning you into an idea person.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Really?!
That'd be great if you're right!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: My initial thought was that I wouldn't mind doing something for class as long as it didn't get in the way of band practice...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: However, since you two came up with such a good idea, I'll try doing what I can for it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yay!
Alright, let's do our best again during tomorrow's discussion!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Thanks to them, we might actually be able to put on a haunted house that even An and others who aren't good with scary things can enjoy...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I hope the four of us get to have lots of fun then...!)
The next day

rows.Speaker: Class President
rows.Line: We'll now begin discussing how we'll be putting everything together for our haunted house. First, let's talk about decorations...

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Wait, shouldn't we start with how we're gonna put up drapes to darken our classroom?

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: That's also important, but don't the routes and layout take priority? We can just use cardboard or our desks to make all the walls we need, right?

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
Hang on! What about costumes?!
How real do the wolves need to look?

rows.Speaker: Class President
rows.Line: U-Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: N-Now that we know what we'll be doing, everyone's super excited about putting a haunted house together...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But the Class President is being bombarded with all these different suggestions...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, there's a lot to do, so getting everyone and everything organized isn't gonna be easy...

rows.Speaker: Class President
rows.Line: Um, so... We should start with...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Wait, I've seen this happen before...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (For the choir recital, Honami said that it was really hard to get everyone to compromise and agree on one plan.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (To be fair, we don't seem to be splitting into two camps like her class.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Class President, I have a suggestion!

rows.Speaker: Class President
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Y-Yes, Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why don't we start by figuring out everything we need to do, and then deciding who's going to be in charge of what task?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That might smooth out this process.

rows.Speaker: Class President
rows.Line:
Oh...
Yes, you're right.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We shouldn't just bombard her with all of our ideas at once. Let's give our suggestions one person at a time.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
R-Right...!
We're sorry...

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: I guess we couldn't help but blurt out every idea that came to mind...

rows.Speaker: Class President
rows.Line:
No, it's okay...
And thank you very much, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's no need to thank me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shiho... That was so cool!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
That really calmed everyone down!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? It did...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, Shiho, you did an amazing job of that! Not many people are able to say what's needed in these sorts of situations.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Most people usually say that I'm being too harsh... But I'm glad what I said helped.

rows.Speaker: Class President
rows.Line: Alright, let's start figuring out everything that we need to do. I ask that you please raise your hand and wait to be called on before speaking!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh! Please, pick me!
I have a lot of suggestions!

rows.Speaker: Class President
rows.Line: Okay, now that we've decided who our task leaders will be, let's call things here for today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm glad we managed to get to assigning roles to everyone today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Unfortunately, Shiho, you're on the maze team, Minori, you're on costumes, and I'll be promoting our haunted house...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha. We got completely split up...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I think the tasks we've been assigned suit us all really well.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah.
It's too bad that we got split up, but let's do our best!

rows.Speaker: Shiho & Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, let's dive right into designing costumes!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Can we start with the designs for the wolves?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Are they gonna be putting on wolf's heads? As for their suits or clothes... What do you think they should wear?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: In terms of how our wolves' faces are gonna look, we can go in a lot of different directions.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Yeah, I just did a quick search. I'm seeing a mix of stuff from anime and really realistic ones...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
How our wolves are gonna look...
Oh, I know!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What if we started by thinking about how our guests are gonna feel when they see them?!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: How they're gonna feel?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! For example... We could put lots of bows and ribbons on them if we want more kids to stop by, or paint on blood if we want them to look really scary!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, it might be good to think about what sort of audience we want to target.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Yeah, that makes a lot of sense...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. To be fair, I'm sort of just parroting what other people told me...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Hmm... Cute is probably the way to go if we want our haunted house to be enjoyable for all ages, but there are plenty of thrill seekers out there... So, why not both?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Good point.
And it'd be pretty boring if all the wolves looked the same. Can we try designing each of them differently?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It'd probably be really fun to see so many different wolves!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Oh, then! Let's make one super scary for the thrill seekers out there!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, like a zombie wolf!
Gimme one second to draw a quick sketch.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The maze team needs to paint trees onto the plywood that are gonna act as the walls for the haunted house, right?

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line: Yup! We already came up with a blueprint. Hinomori, can you have your group work on the exit? We just need each of you to paint three and then we'll be done!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Three trees per person?
Okay, we'll get started on that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I can use this brush to paint on each leaf... Hmm... Painting on plywood's actually pretty fun...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But it feels kinda flat for some reason...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Using just one shade of green is probably the issue... Which means I should add in some shadows.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Here, here and...
Yeah, that looks much better.)

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line: Hey, wanna try lining our trees up to see how they look together?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, sure...
We can line them up by that window...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Mine looks a little too real...
Maybe I should've kept things simple...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
Yours looks so realistic, Hinomori!

rows.Speaker: Classmate D
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I can tell that you worked really hard on it...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Th-Thanks...
But doesn't it kinda stand out?

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line: Huh? I don't think so... Oh, I know!

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line: We can put the cute and cartoonish trees at the entrance. As you venture deeper and deeper into the forest, they'll gradually start looking more real. How creepy would that be?

rows.Speaker: Classmate D
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's a great idea!
Okay, let's try painting a few more realistic trees.

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line: Hinomori, can you show us how you painted yours?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sure, I can do that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Looks like everybody's having fun...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Minori and Shiho are also doing their best, so I need to do the same as we make flyers for our haunted house.)

rows.Speaker: Classmate E
rows.Line:
Hmm... How should our flyers look?
Have any of you made anything like this before?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I might be able to help. I've recently been putting together flyers for some events.

rows.Speaker: Classmate E
rows.Line:
Really?
Can you tell us how you make them?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, I start by taking photos that more or less represent what a particular event's gonna be like. Then I shop them together on my computer.

rows.Speaker: Classmate F
rows.Line:
Photos?
What kind would be good for a haunted house?

rows.Speaker: Classmate E
rows.Line:
Really old mansions come to mind...
But we're having people walk through a forest, so pictures of a real one might work...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A real forest...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I actually went camping a little while ago, so we might be able to use the photos I took then.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They should be on my phone... Oh, here they are! How about the one I took of the forest at night?

rows.Speaker: Classmate E
rows.Line: Whoa! That looks amazing!

rows.Speaker: Classmate F
rows.Line:
You took this, Kohane?!
It looks totally professional!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe... Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Classmate E
rows.Line:
Oh, I really like this one!
It feels nice and creepy.

rows.Speaker: Classmate F
rows.Line:
Yeah, me too!
Mind if we use it, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay, let's go with that.
But we may also want to try making a few flyers that use different fonts and photos.

rows.Speaker: Classmate F
rows.Line:
Yeah, I agree!
It might be fun to try a bunch of variations. We're gonna need all the help we can get from you, Kohane♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wh-What I'm doing is no big deal, really...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I'm glad to see that I could help...

rows.Speaker: Classmate F
rows.Line: Hehe. You've changed so much since the start of the school year, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: H-Huh...? I have...?

rows.Speaker: Classmate E
rows.Line: Yeah, totally! You used to be so quiet, but we've been getting to hear so much more about who you really are lately!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That's because...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Because I have them now...)
A few days later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's see... The classroom with the copy machine should be this one.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (We won't really know how it looks until we print it... But I have a good feeling about this design!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Shiho and Minori's teams also look like they're almost done with their tasks... I'm really looking forward to seeing how everything turns out.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Huh? Over there... That looks like Emu and...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe♪

...!

rows.Line:

rows.Line:
...

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Our School Festival's supposed to be pretty famous and tends to get a lot of visitors.

rows.Line:

rows.Line: I mean, we want as many people to enjoy our haunted house, right?

rows.Line: Also, we had Shiho help us with making it look more realistic!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Oh, okay...

rows.Line: (I do agree with the part about catering to the thrill seekers out there, but I doubt An will be able to handle something like this...)

rows.Line: (But we only use this whenever we feel it's necessary, so there should be nothing for me to worry about...)

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Then, An, you should be our hunter.
You'd feel better if you knew you could fight back, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright, Azusawa, you'll be our Little Red Riding Hood. Akito and I will be the goats.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Y-You can count on me!
I'll blast anything scary that comes our way...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay!
Plus...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If things get really scary, An, I'll be there to protect you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
...!
Okay! Thanks, Kohane!
Inside the Haunted House

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I-It's pretty dark in here...!
But some of these decorations are pretty cute...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, they did a good job of making it feel like a fairytale.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I should be able to handle...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Whoa! Kohane, is this your haunted house?!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Eep! M-Monster!
My gun! Where's my gun?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
An...
That was just Rin!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh? O-Oh, you're right...
Sorry about that, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Relax, will you...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, we're blocking the entrance, so we should probably proceed.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
W-Wait!
We should stick together and...
*Howl*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: *Scream*

*Growl*
*Howl*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: W-Wolf! I have to... Wait, huh?

rows.Speaker: Mischievous Wolf
rows.Line:
*Bark*
*Howl*

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's acting kinda goofy...

rows.Speaker: Mischievous Wolf
rows.Line:
Hm?!
*Howl*

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's raising its arms. Is it trying to intimidate us?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I've seen a different animal do this before...
Red pandas, I think?

rows.Speaker: Mischievous Wolf
rows.Line: *Whimper*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha...!
It's actually kinda cute!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(*Gasp*
Thank goodness! An's smiling!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that I asked Minori to be a cute wolf for us...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Bye bye, Wolfie!

rows.Speaker: Mischievous Wolf
rows.Line: Woof♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, that wolf seemed pretty friendly...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I feel a lot better now!
This much I can handle!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Great!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, let's keep going!

rows.Speaker: Unfettered Wolf
rows.Line:
*Howl*
*Snarl*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wh-What's going on?!
That wolf seems pretty wild!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An, your gun! Now's your chance!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: O-Oh, right! Bang!

rows.Speaker: Unfettered Wolf
rows.Line: *Whimper*

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<You did it!
An, that was so cool!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. You think so?

rows.Speaker: Cute Wolf
rows.Line: *Howl*

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
This one seems much cuter.
However, it doesn't seem like it's about to let us pass.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh. Just leave that to me.
Bang!

rows.Speaker: Cute Wolf
rows.Line: *Whimper*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: How's that? I feel like a pro now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, An, you're doing great!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This is so much fun! It really feels like a video game! I was kinda scared of them jumping out at first, but I've gotten the hang of shooting them!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I can probably handle whatever this place throws at me now!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's good to see that you're enjoying yourself, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, this is pretty mellow as far as haunted houses go. I guess this is about the level An can really handle.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Akito, you don't seem all that bothered by the wolves.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's because I know they're not real. Especially the ones that look goofy and cartoonish. Those aren't gonna...
*Growl*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Uhh...
That one sounded pretty real... Was that...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A real wolf...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I asked Shiho to do a little surprise for us since some of us don't seem to be scared easily, like Shinonome.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hmm... These trees seem much more realistic. Your class has done an excellent job of recreating a dusky forest.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: B-But I have a feeling that something's about to...
*Growl*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
That sound...

rows.Speaker: Zombie Wolf
rows.Line: *Bark*

rows.Speaker: An & Akito
rows.Line:
Eep!!!
Whoa!!!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: W-W-W-Wait a second! That's the zombie wolf Kohane was playing earlier, right?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Its fangs look real...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Try to calm down, Akito, Shiraishi.
You said just now that it's not real, yes?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, I know!
A-An!!! Shoot it so we can...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I... I... I...!
I know! But my hands are shaking too much!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh no...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
An!
Pass me that gun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: K-Kohane...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Here, put on my hat!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Cool! You can do it, Kohane!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So... I aim the gun at the wolf and...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Fire...! Bang! Bang!

rows.Speaker: Zombie Wolf
rows.Line: Guh...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, I think you stunned it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is this our chance to head towards the exit?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's go, you guys!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Geez, that was scary...
My heart's still racing...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I feel pretty tired...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. Me too...
And it was my first time going in as a guest. That was really thrilling.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
So, how was it...?
Did you guys have fun...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It was super fun!
I don't think I've ever seen a haunted house like this one before!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It was scary... But that wasn't a problem because you were there to protect me in the end, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I enjoyed it as well.
I didn't realize haunted houses could be so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, our class did a slightly better one, but we never would've been able to put anything together like that last wolf...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sounds like you all enjoyed yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad for you, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Minori, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, we did! Thank you both for helping me out!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, does that mean...?
Were you both the wolves?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! I was the one that appeared in the beginning, and Shiho was the last one.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What? That really scary one was you, Hinomori? Wow... You put on a really good performance.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, I just tried copying how a real wolf howls... The wolf's head I think did the rest.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, that mask is quite something.
Even when Azusawa was wearing it, I felt that it belonged in a horror film.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I get what you mean...
But did you guys have to make it look so realistic?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Interesting...
I guess you're not as tough as you look.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What? Hey, don't get the wrong idea.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha! You did great too, Akito!
Anyway, Hinomori, Minori, thanks a bunch!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I really wasn't sure what was gonna happen when I had to go chase after An...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But I'm so glad we're smiling like this now.)
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - School Gate

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Man, we got to do so much today!
Every class did something really fun!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Yeah!
The animal cafe, the play, the sweets stall... And the treasure hunt! They were all super fun!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, the riddles for the treasure hunt were particularly intriguing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We probably wouldn't have been able to figure them out if you weren't there, Toya...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. That's going to make Asahina so happy. I'll let her know the next time I meet her.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, you should!
Still, I think the haunted house your class put together was the best!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, thanks for inviting us, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
...!
No, thank you for coming to visit!

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line: “This concludes the second day of the Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy School Festival.”

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line: “The night festival will begin at half past five. Students, after you've finished cleaning and putting everything away, please gather in the gym.”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I should head back...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay. Have fun, Kohane.
We'll see you tomorrow at practice!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay, that should do it for our classroom...
Which just leaves...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Kohane, Minori, are either of you free? I need someone to help move the desks back.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, Shiho.
Sure, I'll help.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Still... The School Festival's already over...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's a little sad that our school is going to return to the way it was.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, just because it's over, it doesn't mean that it's gone forever.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It may be physically gone, but the memories we made are here to stay.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I always feel the same way after idol concerts, but remembering how much fun they were wins every time!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, I'm sure all of us, our guests included, will also remember how amazing this day was!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, you should!
Still, I think the haunted house your class put together was the best!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, thanks for inviting us, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, you're absolutely right...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
And it's not over yet.
We still get to enjoy the night festival.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, I totally forgot!
Your band's gonna perform, right, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, so I'm gonna have to go in a bit to rehearse once we're done cleaning up here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. We'll be rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thanks.
I hope you're both looking forward to seeing an awesome show.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I really appreciate the way you both helped me today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Because you two helped me look for An and listened when I asked for help, everyone ended up having a really good time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So... Thank you both so much.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's no need to thank us...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. But... You're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm also really glad that An and the others enjoyed our haunted house so much!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm really glad too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm standing here today because of my teammates, so I wanted them to have as much fun as they could today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Because of your teammates...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know exactly how you feel...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The others in MORE MORE JUMP! have always been there to help me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The designs for our costumes, how to act as a wolf and all our other ideas... I doubt that I would've been able to contribute this much if it weren't for them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So... I really understand how you feel when you say that you have your teammates to thank for everything, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Same...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Ichika and the others are probably the reason why I've been changing little by little.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's make our haunted house really fun and thrilling!

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line: Hinomori, can you show us how you painted yours?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I never would've thought that I'd be enjoying the School Festival with my classmates like this at the beginning of the year.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shiho? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, nothing's wrong...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Are you sure?
Your face sorta said otherwise!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
It's nothing, really.
And I wouldn't tell you even if something was going on.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... The sun's already starting to set.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, we gotta hurry up and move these desks!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right. I need to rehearse soon too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Time really flew by...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But it ended up being a really fun festival.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. It was pretty good.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm so happy to see that you enjoyed the School Festival, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Whoa, Minori...
What's with this sudden burst of energy?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. Oh, Minori...
But I get how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, geez. You too, Kohane?
Quit grinning and help me stop Minori, will you...?
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: School's back to being a school again...

rows.Speaker: Student
rows.Line: Hey, isn't that...?

rows.Speaker: Student
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's definitely her.
But still? Really? I wouldn't have expected her to do anything like that... I guess you can never tell...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Huh...? Is it just me or is everybody looking at me...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wait...
There's a big crowd in front of the bulletin board...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Good morning, you two.
What's going on here?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, um... You might want to just look.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh? Look where... The school paper?
What does that have to...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wh-What...?!

rows.Speaker: School Newspaper
rows.Line: “Mysterious Zombie Wolf Makes Unprecedented Appearance At Miya Girls School Festival!”

rows.Speaker: School Newspaper
rows.Line: “Eyewitness accounts indicate that, to the surprise of the students, the repulsive wolf wandered its way into several different classes. Fortunately, the festival guests attested that they enjoyed every minute of it!”

rows.Speaker: School Newspaper
rows.Line: “And the person behind the mask turned out to be none other than — Kohane Azusawa of Class 1-A!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: W-Wait, when did this...?

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
Azusawa!
Is what the paper says true?!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
Also, weren't you in Class B's play?!
The way it ended was so good!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: I didn't realize you were so outgoing, Azusawa...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, um... Hold on...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-You're all getting the wrong idea...!!!
